title: Petch Chueluecha
text:
My name is Suchakree “Petch” Chueluecha. I am a sixth-year PhD candidate in Mathematics at the University of Virginia, working under the supervision of Jennifer Morse.
I am on the job market for Fall 2027.
I received my B.S. in Mathematics from Lehigh University in 2021.
My research interests lie in algebraic combinatorics, particularly in the study of modified Macdonald polynomials, Catalan functions, \(k\)-Schur functions, and \(k\)-shapes.
I was born in Bangkok, Thailand, and moved to the United States at age 18. Outside of mathematics, I enjoy exploring global cuisines, music and singing, financial market analysis, chess, and contributing to strategy, coordination, and community building as a member of the leadership team of a top alliance in Last War on Server 598.
